import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source_path_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_82/training_0.csv"

# Target output path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_82/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
df_source_0 = pd.read_csv(source_path_0, index_col=0)

# Group by conservation_status and count distinct scientific_name
df_target = (
    df_source_0
    .groupby('conservation_status')['scientific_name']
    .nunique()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'scientific_name': 'scientific_name'})
)

# Ensure the scientific_name column is integer type
df_target['scientific_name'] = df_target['scientific_name'].astype(int)

# Save the transformed data to the target CSV file
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source table
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_82/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Union (only one table, so just use it)
df_union = source0

# Group by conservation_status and count scientific_name
result = df_union.groupby('conservation_status', dropna=False).agg({'scientific_name': 'count'}).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
result.columns = ['conservation_status', 'scientific_name']

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_82/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
